title: hieracium leiopogon subsp. flahaultianum
intro: Hieracium leiopogon subsp. flahaultianum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium leiopogon subsp. flahaultianum include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
